facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Fogg arrived in India. The train was late! Every minute was important. Every minute counted.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Fogg and Passepartout reached India, but the train was delayed. They could not waste even a single minute on this tight schedule. Fogg calmly found a solution — he hired an elephant! They rode through the jungle to make up for lost time. Every minute counted. Fogg showed that creative thinking saves precious minutes.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: Upon arriving in India, Fogg and Passepartout encountered their first serious obstacle. The railway line they needed was incomplete, ending abruptly in the middle of the countryside. While most travelers would have panicked, Fogg immediately searched for an alternative solution. He purchased an elephant at an enormous price and hired a guide to cross the dense jungle. Every minute counted. However, this detour through the jungle would lead to an unexpected encounter that changed everything. Because Fogg valued every minute and refused to waste time complaining, he always found a way forward. This experience proved that flexibility and quick decision-making are just as important as having a perfect plan.
facts.Word cards: counted = 중요했다 / set off = 출발했다 / tight = 빠듯한 / destination = 목적지
